description: Iteration 22 additional hand-read marks on the '#17 Shovel' recording (same pixel convention as shots/21-shovel/marks.json: decoded 2556 x 1180 recording frame). Used to measure figure rotations and the static figures' poses. Status: traced. Read by the AI (2026-10-04), not reviewed by the user.

blade_marks.note: Lower (ice-contact) edge of a skater/goalie blade: heel = where the blade leaves the shaft bend, toe = far end. Mapped to the ice plane with the segment-1 homography; the figure heading follows from the blade direction (asset blade heel/toe in validation/players/figures-report.json) and the pivot from the blade position. Toe marks beyond the visible blade end only fix the direction.
